sources.title: Taxi.ipynb - Colab
sources.snippet: Taxi V3 The taxi problem was first introduced in Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with the MAXQ Value Function Decomposition. In this environment, the agent controls a taxi whose job is to pick up a passenger at one location and drop him off in his target location. Dropping of the passenger to its destination leads to a +20 reward.
